// diagnostic

E0957

`embed_file`/`embed_bytes` path or `find` glob not a literal, absolute, or escaping via `..`

What

`embed_file`/`embed_bytes` path or `find` glob not a literal, absolute, or escaping via `..`

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Use a literal relative path or glob that stays inside the project.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0957: tests/ui/comptime_embed_absolute.stderr.

Error [jet.InvalidEmbedPath]: `embed_file` path must be relative
  --> tests/ui/comptime_embed_absolute.jet:1:17
    |
  1 | D :: comptime { embed_file("/etc/passwd") }
    |                 ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: An absolute path reaches outside the project
 Fix: Use a path relative to this file's own directory
